title: Most Indians descend from two ancient populations
sources: B. S. Guha, Census of India 1931 racial classification
Reich et al., 'Reconstructing Indian Population History', Nature (2009)

quiz.q: The 2009 study described most Indians as a mix of:
quiz.why: Right. Ancestral North Indians and Ancestral South Indians.
